scripts.prod:psql: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec db psql -U shuf -d shuf
scripts.prod:migrate: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec app node server/migrate.ts
scripts.prod:trust: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec caddy caddy trust
scripts.prod:backup: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec -T db pg_dump -U shuf -d shuf --no-owner --no-privileges > backup.sql
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U shuf -d shuf
scripts.db:dump: docker compose exec -T db pg_dump -U shuf -d shuf --clean --if-exists --no-owner --no-privileges --exclude-schema=app > db/dump.sql
scripts.db:restore: docker compose exec -T db psql -U shuf -d shuf -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < db/dump.sql
